verdict.rationale: Brave ships an official MCP server with well-defined tool schemas (web/local/image/video/news search, LLM context, summarization) plus first-party integration guides for Claude Desktop, Open WebUI, n8n, Dify, and OpenClaw, and documents an LLM Context endpoint 'built for machine consumption' — strong direct evidence of ready-made agent tool integration. However, community evidence shows the free-tier ToS explicitly prohibits using responses for AI inference, requiring a separate paid AI Inference plan to legitimately use it in agents, and no official OpenAPI/function-calling schema was found (openapi probes 404). Missing for 10: publicly discoverable OpenAPI/function-calling JSON schema, and resolution of the ToS friction for standard-tier agent use.
